summary: Frontend-only testing of the new COC/CVO one-time announcement popup (CocAnnouncementPopup). All 6 scenarios passed: dealer sees popup on fresh login after ~1.5s; content includes COC/CVO, Yamaha/Kawasaki/KTM €75, Triumph €120, and Honda exception; 'Begrepen' dismiss closes popup and writes localStorage key 'coc_announcement_seen_{userId}_v1'; reload does NOT re-show popup; 'Bekijk aanbod' CTA closes popup, persists localStorage, and keeps user on /dealer; admin and pakbon roles do NOT see the popup. Coexists with other popups (WelcomePopup / Google promo) without conflict.

issues: Radix Dialog warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for DialogContent' - non-blocking accessibility warning. Consider adding a DialogDescription for a11y.

action_items: Optional a11y improvement: add <DialogDescription> to CocAnnouncementPopup to satisfy Radix Dialog aria-describedby requirement (currently logs a React warning).
critical_code_review_comments: Component is clean, well-scoped, uses versioned localStorage key ('coc_announcement_seen_{userId}_v1') which allows future re-announcements by bumping ANNOUNCEMENT_VERSION.
Correctly guards on user.role === 'dealer' && !user.is_foreign_dealer so admin/pakbon/foreign dealers are excluded.
Minor: Dialog is missing DialogDescription -> causes accessibility console warning but no functional impact.

Minor: goToMotorcycles navigates to '/dealer' which is typically where the dealer already is after login; CTA could be enhanced later to navigate to a concrete 'new order' flow, but matches the provided spec.
